name: Iwakura Aria
source:
A girl who lives in a vast mansion in Nishigahara, Kita Ward. She boasts divine beauty and gives off a cold aura that keeps others away, but she is friendly to all guests except [url=/c135595/]Ichiko[/url]. 

She is physically weak and does not eat much. She was homeschooled and has rarely left the mansion. 

[Edited from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/iwakura-aria/]official website[/url]]
